triage.note:
ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. Chevron FY2015 items 7 and 8 read, in full: item 7 -- 'Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

The index to Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data is presented on page FS-1.' (280 chars); item 8 -- 'Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

The index to Management's Discussion and Analysis, Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data is presented on page FS-1.' (189 chars). Both report status=extracted, confidence=0.95. The actual MD&A and financial statements are real content sitting in this SAME document's tail -- 294,291 chars outside every item span (16 'FS-1' hits, 18 'Consolidated Statement of Income' hits, 2 auditor reports) -- reached only by resolving 'page FS-1', an internal pagination reference, not an external-document pointer. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: ADR-004 rules that an internal pointer cannot make an item `incorporated_by_reference` -- correct, since nothing is actually incorporated from outside the document, there is nothing to fetch. That leaves the pointer paragraph itself as the item's only body, which is non-empty ordinary prose (not the ba-2003 empty-body shape), so ADR-005's rules pass it through as `extracted` at full confidence with nothing to object to at the single-item level classify() operates at. Closing the gap would mean resolving an intra-document page/pagination reference ('page FS-1') to find and attach the real content -- a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze, not a defect in an existing layer. The two asserted min_chars checks encode what would be true if that capability existed (the real MD&A/financial-statement text, not just the one-sentence pointer, ends up in the span) and are expected to stay red until a post-freeze ADR admits the capability. WHY THIS IS A DISTINCT VARIANT, NOT A DUPLICATE OF ba-2003: ba-2003 items 11/13 have a genuinely empty body (34/59 chars, heading + page furniture only) and the missing reference is a footnote naming OTHER items in the SAME document; wfc-2008 (ADR-017, already fixed) was an EXTERNAL pointer whose phrasing simply didn't match IBR_RE. cvx-2015 items 7/8 have a non-empty, well-formed pointer sentence whose destination is an internal page number in THIS document's own tail -- the short_span check (floor 100) does not fire (280/189 chars, well clear of the floor), and low_span_coverage DID fire in the stdlib oracle but was triaged away as 'exhibit attachments', the same story that correctly explains ge-1994's pension-note tail and incorrectly explains this one (see the planning-pass audit, scratchpad t11-my-audit.md section C, for the full triage-of-a-true-positive writeup). STANDING DISAGREEMENT, RECORDED NOT RESOLVED: the extraction-auditor's independent blind sample (docs/evals/audits/2026-08-19-t11-silent-failure-sample.md, item #21) adjudicated cvx-2015 item 6 -- 'Item 6. Selected Financial Data

The selected financial data for years 2011 through 2015 are presented on page FS-60.' -- the identical shape (short pointer body, internal page reference, real content in the document tail) -- and ruled it CORRECT. That verdict was never reconciled against this same planning pass's reading of items 7/8 as the silent-failure shape this repo exists to hunt; items 7 and 8 themselves were never independently adjudicated by the auditor (they were outside its 30-case sample). This case therefore asserts the debt for items 7/8 only, not item 6 -- resolving the item-6 disagreement by assertion would violate the auditor's own charter for a standing disagreement between two independent reads of the same shape. Sibling instance noted for the record, not covered by a case here: ge-1994 item 8 (86 chars, 'See index under item 14.') is the same internal-pointer-to-paginated-section shape one era earlier. WHY THIS CASE IS PERMITTED TO STAY RED (D9 ruling, 2026-08-26): specs/decisions/ADR-034-pointer-and-fanout-rulings.md splits this class in two and rules on each. cvx-2015 items 7/8 are sub-class A2 -- a few pointer-bodied items inside an otherwise well-extracted filing (coverage 27.2%, 113,501 of 417,517 chars in spans) -- and A2 is DECLINED, not promoted, for two measured reasons: the extraction-auditor's blind sample adjudicated cvx-2015 item 6, the identical shape, CORRECT, and that disagreement is still unresolved (ADR-019 section e), so a capability milestone would be fixing something two independent reads disagree is broken; and the D8 item-level trigger as its ledger row specifies it (item 1's span under 2,000 chars) is MEASURED SILENT on this filing -- item 1 is full-length -- so D11's slow tier will not reach it either. ADR-034 section f names what reopens the decline: one instance both reads agree is wrong, or one fire of the shipped D8 trigger on any A2 filing. The two min_chars checks stay red until then and that is now a recorded decision rather than an unexplained red. ADR-034 section b3 also records that this row and ADR-019 section e UNDERSTATE the class: cvx-2015 items 2 and 7A are unnamed members of the same shape, and bac-2006 items 3/6/7A and spatz-2014 item 8 are unenumerated instances in other filings -- logged as debt, not added to this case. ADJUDICATED 2026-08-27 by ADR-038 (D13) -- READ THIS BEFORE TREATING THIS CASE'S RED AS THE DEFECT. specs/decisions/ADR-038-internal-pointer-adjudication.md states a rule before applying it and adjudicates every enumerated item, with the extraction-auditor re-run BLIND on a nine-item sample (tasks/reviews/d13-auditor-verdicts.md, verbatim). ITEMS 7 AND 8 -- the two items THIS case asserts -- ARE RULED `correct`. The span is the item's text verbatim, which is the only thing `extracted` claims (INV-S2), so ADR-004 shape 2 and ADR-005 both STAND; and ADR-035's `item_span_near_empty`, built after the STANDING DISAGREEMENT paragraph above was written, now carries both at confidence 0.80 with review_required=true, so the envelope no longer reports them clean. What is ruled DEFECT is items 2, 6 and 7A of this same filing: pointer-only bodies whose named targets lie in the 294,291-char region outside every span, published at 0.95 with review_required=false and no warning carrying their code. Those three are asserted by the sibling case evals/adversarial/cvx-2015-silent-pointer-items.json, watched red. CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS CASE, RECORDED NOT ACTED ON: its two min_chars checks encode a CAPABILITY outcome (the real MD&A/financial-statement text inside items 7/8's spans) on the two items the ruling calls correct, so its red now means 'internal-pointer resolution is not built', not 'this is broken'. Re-authoring the assertion set is logged as TD-156 rather than done here -- D13's spec was to rule, not to re-author, and re-authoring changes what is red. THE ITEM-6 DISAGREEMENT IS SETTLED AND ADR-034 section f row 2's REOPENER IS TRIPPED: both reads now hold item 6 WRONG (threshold was one instance both reads agree is wrong), which also resolves ADR-019 section b's 1/30-vs-2/30 sensitivity to 2/30. A2 is still NOT promoted -- ADR-038 section e1 -- because the adjudicated defect is the escalation layer's item set (TD-5), not internal-pointer resolution. A NEW STANDING DISAGREEMENT REPLACES THE OLD ONE, NARROWER: the blind auditor rules bac-2006 items 3 and 6 WRONG where ADR-038 rules them `correct`, on a ground ADR-038 section d3 states it has no reply to -- 0.95 with review_required=false on a doc_status=success envelope with warnings=[]. Recorded as a disagreement, not resolved by fiat.
